edits.source: that there's actually a real performance problem when someone reports a performance issue we need to ask probing questions what make us think there's a problem has the system ever performed better what recent changes might have affected performance can we quantify what slow means in this context is the issue affecting multiple users or just one these questions aren't just formalities they help clarify the issue establish a baseline for comparison and sometimes even resolve the problem
